name: The X Protocol
overview:
Louiser and White, who discover disturbing secrets surrounding their school principal and a haunting connected to events dating back to 1990. As they investigate, they become entangled in a series of paranormal occurrences and hidden truths.

Overview

Genre: Horror, Mystery, Supernatural

Setting: A school environment with links to past events.

Main Characters: Louiser and White.

Core Premise: Two students uncover a haunting mystery tied to their principal and must confront terrifying supernatural forces while uncovering the truth.

Themes

Hidden secrets from the past

School-based supernatural horror

Friendship and investigation

Psychological fear and hauntings
